layout_strategy: Mobile-First App Layout. On desktop, center the content inside a max-w-md container with a shadow to mimic a mobile screen, or just make it fully responsive. Use a sticky bottom navigation bar for core tabs (Home, Orders, Notifications, Profile). Use sticky headers with backdrop-blur-xl (Glassmorphism).

components.buttons: Primary: bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-medium shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20. Secondary: bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-full py-4 px-6 font-medium.
components.cards: bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 border border-slate-100 shadow-sm.
components.inputs: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 rounded-2xl px-4 py-4 text-slate-900 focus:bg-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-50 outline-none transition-all.
components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-100 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50.
components.service_selector: Card with an icon, title, and a small counter (-, 0, +) at the bottom. Selected state gives the card a border-blue-500 and bg-blue-50.
components.date_time_picker: Horizontal scrollable list for dates (Day of week + Date number). Grid for time slots. Selected items turn solid primary color.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and enhanced shadow on interactive cards.
motion.page_transition: Framer motion page variants (fade in, slide up slightly).
motion.tap: scale-95 on buttons for tactile feedback.

image_urls.description: Clean neatly folded pastel towels, fresh laundry aesthetic
Person relaxing in a modern bright room, carefree lifestyle
3D clay illustration of a laundry delivery box
Smiling female avatar for the user profile

key_screens_and_flow.auth: OTP mobile number signup. Clean large typography, minimal form.
key_screens_and_flow.home: Top user greeting + location. Swiper for banners. CSS Grid for services (Wash & Fold, Dry Clean, Ironing, Steam Press, Premium Wash). Floating action bar activates when items > 0 to 'Schedule Pickup'.
key_screens_and_flow.schedule_pickup: Sequential flow (or single scrolling bottom sheet): 1. Select Date, 2. Select Time Slot, 3. Select/Add Address, 4. Confirm Booking.
key_screens_and_flow.orders: Tabs: 'Active' & 'Past'. Cards display order ID, date, status, total cost. Clicking opens detail view.
key_screens_and_flow.order_detail: Vertical timeline tracking (Order Placed, Picked Up, Washing, Out for Delivery, Delivered).
key_screens_and_flow.profile: List of settings, 'Saved Addresses' management screen, past orders link.
key_screens_and_flow.notifications: List of recent alerts, unread items highlighted with a blue dot or background tint.

accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selectable cards, tabs, menu items) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case (e.g., 'login-submit-button', 'service-wash-fold-card', 'nav-profile-tab').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure sufficient contrast for text, especially when using primary-light backgrounds.
